title: Mastering XRR Fitting: Fitting X-Ray Reflectivity Curves with X-Ray Calc 3
description:
A free book on fitting an X-ray reflectivity (XRR) curve, from reading the raw curve to reporting the fit. It is written for a graduate student or engineer who has an XRR curve and has never fitted one, and it teaches the physics that fitting needs and no more. Every step is done in one program, X-Ray Calc 3 (https://github.com/OleksiyPenkov/X-RayCalc3), version 3.9.4.

The method is the laboratory fitting procedure of Penkov, Peng and Fu (arXiv:2609.28926), turned back into the actions of the program's graphical interface. The worked examples use measured curves of Co/C multilayers and single films from the procedure's deposit.

The record holds the source of the book and of its web edition (https://oleksiypenkov.github.io/MasteringXRR/). The PDF edition is attached to each GitHub release: https://github.com/OleksiyPenkov/MasteringXRR/releases/latest/download/Mastering-XRR-Fitting.pdf
